import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_68/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_68/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source4_68_0 and Source4_68_1 on 'school_name'
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="school_name", how="inner")

# Group by school_name and type (which corresponds to target columns 'school_name' and 'a')
# Aggregations:
# sum of size -> target column 'b' (integer)
# sum of budget -> target column 'c' (integer)
# sum of reading_score -> target column 'd' (float)
# sum of math_score -> target column 'e' (float)
agg = joined.groupby(["school_name", "type"], as_index=False).agg({
    "size": "sum",
    "budget": "sum",
    "reading_score": "sum",
    "math_score": "sum"
})

# Rename columns to match target schema
agg = agg.rename(columns={
    "school_name": "school_name",
    "type": "a",
    "size": "b",
    "budget": "c",
    "reading_score": "d",
    "math_score": "e"
})

# Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema
agg["school_name"] = agg["school_name"].astype(str)
agg["a"] = agg["a"].astype(str)
agg["b"] = agg["b"].astype(int)
agg["c"] = agg["c"].astype(int)
agg["d"] = agg["d"].astype(float)
agg["e"] = agg["e"].astype(float)

# Reorder columns to match target schema order
agg = agg[["school_name", "a", "b", "c", "d", "e"]]

# Save to target path
agg.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_68/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_68/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_68/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on school_name
df = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="school_name", how="inner")

# Group by school_name
# Aggregations:
# - a: first(type)
# - b: sum(size)
# - c: sum(budget)
# - d: mean(reading_score)
# - e: mean(math_score)
agg_df = df.groupby("school_name").agg({
    "type": "first",
    "size": "sum",
    "budget": "sum",
    "reading_score": "mean",
    "math_score": "mean"
}).reset_index()

# Rename columns to match target schema
agg_df = agg_df.rename(columns={
    "type": "a",
    "size": "b",
    "budget": "c",
    "reading_score": "d",
    "math_score": "e"
})

# Ensure correct column order as per target schema
agg_df = agg_df[["school_name", "a", "b", "c", "d", "e"]]

# Write output
agg_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_68/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
